cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you go, read the final dinner bill with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. First I'd like us both to see what 'just a starter' cost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Let's meet your share while it's still printed clearly.
